decision.rationale: I recommend a provisional credit of 195.89 EUR. TXN-008087 on card CRD-000228 at Bramble Devices posted on 2026-08-07. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-28, 82 days later, which is within the 120-day limit (time-limits). The card was charged 685.62 EUR (68562 cents). The approved authorisation AUTH-008278 was for 489.73 EUR (48973 cents). The merchant's own receipt DOC-000064 also shows a total of 489.73 EUR. The charge is higher than both the receipt and the authorisation, so under amount-above-receipt the extra amount was charged without agreement. Only the difference is credited: 68562 - 48973 = 19589 cents (195.89 EUR). This matches the amount the cardholder claims and is well under the 3,000.00 EUR limit for automatic credit (provisional-credit). The documents contained no instructions to follow.
